title: Signed package envelope v2 (DRAFT — Phase 1 PLG-101 locks it)
description: Successor to the v1 package-manifest.json. Adds the candidate public key / certificate chain (required for safe unknown-publisher approval), rotation co-signing, and revocation pointers. Signature is Ed25519 over the RAW canonical payload bytes (no re-canonicalization surface). Applies to both .formlogic-plugin and .formlogic-app archives.

publisherKey.description: The candidate public key material the verifier shows BEFORE any trust prompt.

certChainPem.description: optional X.509 chain when an external CA anchors the publisher

catalogAssertion.description: optional reference to an independently trusted catalog record

rotation.description: Present when this key supersedes an older publisher key: the payload is co-signed by BOTH.

payloadB64.description: base64 of the canonical payload JSON: { name, version, createdAt, kind: 'plugin'|'app', files: [{ path (normalized, case-folded-unique, Windows-safe), sha256, size }], channel?, minDesktopVersion?, driverFlavour?, rebootRequired? }. Every executable/loadable file MUST be listed; manifest.json itself MUST be listed; version MUST equal the manifest + channel versions.
